subject: Public Health Excellence Inter-Municipal Agreement
overview: The board reviewed results from the annual unhoused population count and findings from a study on cultural barriers to behavioral health services. Members also discussed a regional inter-municipal agreement to secure grant funding for shared public health staff.

items.title: Social Services Coordinator Introduction and PIT Count
items.summary: Social Services Coordinator Jason Stone discussed his role as a service connector and reported that the January Point in Time count identified approximately 14 unhoused individuals in Medford.

items.title: Cultural Connections to Care Presentation
items.summary: Catherine Dinger presented findings from a study on behavioral health barriers for immigrant and BIPOC communities, noting that stigma, language access, and insurance costs remain primary obstacles to care.

items.title: Public Health Excellence Shared Services IMA
items.summary: The board reviewed a proposed inter-municipal agreement for a regional collaborative that provides $561,000 in annual grant funding for shared staff, including a regional epidemiologist and public health nurse. Dr. Plodwitz requested summary documentation and fiscal oversight details before board members and the mayor sign the agreement.
